prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 766px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较重点城市各季度GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的经济表现。","reading":"读者沿行查看同一城市的季度变化和说明，也会沿列比较各城市在同一季度的增速；说明文字较长，很可能主导各数据行的高度。","groups":["第一列城市名称用于定位整行。","第二至第五列都是季度增速，承担相同的比较功能，宜保持一致的视觉权重。","第六列说明为各城市的数值提供背景，与同一行的数据共同阅读。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称","季度增速数值及其小数点","百分号"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文叙述可自然换行，并利用说明文字形成的行高。","季度子表头可换行，但应保持四个季度一致的处理方式。","跨四列的季度增速总表头在必要时可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [52, 51, 51, 51, 51, 103] · table 360×1454px · row heights [36, 83, 269, 222, 199, 199, 222, 222] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [52, 47, 47, 47, 47, 119] · table 360×1244px · row heights [36, 83, 222, 199, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [51, 43, 43, 43, 43, 136] · table 360×1105px · row heights [36, 83, 199, 176, 153, 153, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 5/7 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"城市名称和增速数值完整，四个季度等宽，便于横向和纵向比较。","problems":"说明栏过窄，叙述被切成很短的行，导致数据行高大、季度数字下方留白过多；季度子表头也逐字换行。","cause":"说明栏仅103px，扣除边距和边框后可用宽度约82px；季度列各51px，仍不足以容纳完整的三字子表头。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"城市名称和数字保持完整，等宽季度列仍有清晰的比较节奏；说明栏比r2A宽，行高和空白有所减少。","problems":"说明文字仍显拥挤，数据行偏高；四个季度子表头仍各占三行。","cause":"季度列各缩至47px，但说明栏119px的可用文字宽度仍只有约98px；季度列也不足以让子表头完整显示。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"说明栏更宽，叙述较易连续阅读，行高进一步下降；季度数字仍完整，四列保持一致。","problems":"城市表头和城市名称都断成两行，削弱了行的定位作用；季度子表头仍逐字换行，数字列也较紧。","cause":"城市列51px扣除21px后仅余30px，略小于城市名称所需的31px；季度列各43px，说明栏因此获得136px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"保留城市名称","widths":[52,43,43,43,43,135],"change":"以r2C为基础，将城市列加宽1px以容纳完整名称，说明栏相应减1px；保留等宽季度列和较宽的说明栏。"},{"name":"季度稍宽","widths":[52,44,44,44,44,131],"change":"保持城市名称完整，将每个季度列加宽1px，为数字和列间节奏留出更多空间，同时保留较宽的说明栏。"},{"name":"均衡留白","widths":[52,46,46,46,46,123],"change":"在城市名称完整的前提下进一步加宽四个季度列，测试数据区更从容的比例与说明栏行高之间的取舍。"}]}
